description:
Set a take profit and/or stop loss on an ALREADY-OPEN perp position (non-custodial).

place_perp_order can attach TP/SL only inline on the order that OPENS a
position; this adds one to a position that is already open.
Currently supported on Jupiter Perps (position_id = the position pubkey,
as returned by perp_positions_all); other venues are refused.

At least one of take_profit_price / stop_loss_price is required. size_pct
in (0, 100] is how much of the position the trigger closes. Both are
passed through exactly as given -- Crank never chooses or adjusts a
trigger price or size. Returns an UNSIGNED transaction to sign; Crank
never signs.

``jurisdiction``: geo-gated like every perps write,
including the AU block -- see place_perp_order.

``idempotency_key`` (optional): see cancel_perp_order -- reuse the same key
across the build call and its ``signed_transaction`` completion call.

``signed_transaction`` / ``verify`` (two-phase execution): see
place_perp_order. A TP/SL moves no position when set, so confirming the
signature landed IS the verification.

``venue_action`` (optional, completion leg only): pass back the build
leg's ``extra['venue_action']`` (Jupiter's create-tpsl) so the signed
bytes are relayed through the venue's own execute endpoint.
name: set_perp_tpsl
